blocks.html:
Create or replace a layout configuration for a zone. Set `is_default` to
update the zone's system default (applies to all users) instead of the
current user's personal configuration.

children.name: is_default
children.description:
Whether to set the zone's system default configuration (applies to all
users) instead of the current user's personal configuration.

children.name: configuration
children.description: The layout configuration settings.

children.name: widgets
children.description: Per-widget placement and visibility preferences, keyed by widget ID.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description:
Create or replace a layout configuration for a zone. Set `is_default` to
update the zone's system default (applies to all users) instead of the
current user's personal configuration.

children.name: personal_configuration
children.description:
The current user's personal layout configuration for the zone, or null if
they have not saved one.

children.name: id
children.description: The layout configuration's ID.

children.name: zone
children.description: The zone (page) this configuration is for, e.g. "product.details".

children.name: user_id
children.description: The ID of the user who owns this configuration, or null for the system default.

children.name: is_system_default
children.description: Whether this is the system default configuration for the zone.

children.name: configuration
children.description: The layout configuration settings.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the layout configuration was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the layout configuration was updated.

children.name: default_configuration
children.description:
The zone's system default layout configuration (applies to all users), or
null if none has been saved.

children.name: id
children.description: The layout configuration's ID.

children.name: zone
children.description: The zone (page) this configuration is for, e.g. "product.details".

children.name: user_id
children.description: The ID of the user who owns this configuration, or null for the system default.

children.name: is_system_default
children.description: Whether this is the system default configuration for the zone.

children.name: configuration
children.description: The layout configuration settings.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the layout configuration was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the layout configuration was updated.

children.name: active_scope
children.description:
The scope the current user is actively viewing for this zone — their
persisted choice, falling back to "personal" when they have a personal
configuration and "default" otherwise.
